Glosario de Draft 20: draft, subasta, pu: Draft 20 Glossary: draft, auction, bid and more
Todos los términos de Draft 20 explicado: All Draft 20 terms explained: draft, auction, bid, I'M OUT, ⭐ value, 4-item cap, deadlock, rematch and series.
Los términos que aparecen en el juego y: The terms that appear in the game and in the guides, explained in one sentence. If you're new here, start with
Formato en el que se reparte un presupue: A format where a fixed budget is spread across a list of items and you have to build the best possible selection. In Draft 20, each player gets 20 coins.
En cada ronda sale un ítem y los dos jug: Each round an item comes up and the two players bid in turns. When someone drops out, the last bidder pays the price and takes the item.
Oferta que sube el precio actual del íte: An offer that raises the current price of the item. In Draft 20 there are only two buttons: BID +1 and BID +3.
Retirarse de la subasta. Si el rival es: Withdraw from the auction. If your rival is the last bidder, they pay the price and keep the item; you spend nothing.
Jugador que marcó el precio actual. Si e: The player who set the current price. If their rival drops out, they pay and take the item; that's why it pays to time your bids.
Calidad intrínseca de cada ítem, en una: The intrinsic quality of each item, on a scale from 1 to 10. It stays secret until the end of the game and decides the winner.
Cada elemento que se subasta: un persona: Each item up for auction: a character, an object or a dish. Every theme has 20 different items.
La lista de 20 ítems sobre la que se jue: The list of 20 items the game is played with (football, anime, food, streamers…). Draft 20 has 69 themes.
Máximo de ítems por jugador. Al llegar a: Maximum items per player. Once you reach 4, any items that come up later go straight to your rival.
Si te toca un ítem fresco y no tienes di: If a fresh item comes up and you have no money, press PASS: your rival decides whether to keep it for 1 🪙 or give it to you.
Modo opcional que muestra el ⭐ de cada í: Optional mode that shows each item's ⭐ during the game. It is set by whoever creates the room and affects both players.
Al terminar, cualquiera puede proponer u: At the end, either player can propose a rematch with a new theme; the rival accepts or declines it from the final screen.
Marcador de revanchas contra el mismo ri: Rematch score against the same rival: whoever wins two games takes the series.
Rival controlado por la máquina con cuat: A machine-controlled rival with four levels: Easy, Normal, Hard and Extreme. It lets you practice without a human opponent.
Qué es Draft 20, de dónde viene la idea: What Draft 20 is, where the 20-coin draft idea comes from and who is behind it.
La idea es convertir esa dinámica en un: The idea is to turn that dynamic into a quick two-player duel: one theme, 20 items, 20 coins and 8 rounds of turn-based bidding. Five minutes, a rematch and on to something else.
Es un proyecto independiente hecho en Es: It is an independent project made in Spain, with no accounts, no downloads and no advertising. If you have ideas, suggestions or find a bug, write to us.
Para dudas, sugerencias, errores o colab: For questions, suggestions, bugs or collaborations, write to us by email. We reply as soon as possible.
Cuéntanos qué estabas haciendo cuando oc: Tell us what you were doing when it happened (theme, phone or computer) and, if it was a bug, what you expected to happen. We usually reply within a couple of days.
La página que buscas no existe o ha camb: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved. Go back home or explore a theme.
El bot juega con las mismas reglas que t: The bot plays by the same rules as you. Easy and Normal guess item values (with varying accuracy), Hard knows them and manages its budget, and Extreme plays aggressively with the real values. Each level is calibrated against an average player (30/50/70/90% win rates).
No malgastes las 20 monedas en la primer: Don't waste your 20 coins on the first round: the good items tend to come mixed in.
Con 4 ítems estás al máximo: los siguien: With 4 items you are at the maximum: the next ones pass to your rival.

El sitio ofrece un juego gratuito de sub: The site offers a free turn-based auction game for two players. It requires no registration or payments and currently does not display advertising; if it is added in the future, it will be announced here and in the [[privacidad]]. No personal data is collected beyond what is described in that policy.
No hay cuentas ni perfiles. Las salas gu: There are no accounts or profiles. Rooms only store the name you type (optional) and the game status on the server, and are automatically deleted after a few hours. When a practice game ends, an anonymous record is saved (level, mode, result and moves; without names or identifiers) to calibrate the bot's difficulty. When any game ends, including against the CPU, an anonymous record is saved (theme, mode, time and result; without names or identifiers) for the statistics of modes played.
Tu navegador guarda en localStorage dato: Your browser saves game data in localStorage (room session, wins record, bot difficulty and a record of your practice games) and your cookie choice. It never leaves your device and you can delete it by clearing the site's data.
La cerveza se bebe rápido y se puja más: Beer is drunk fast and bid on even faster: games fly by because almost no one hesitates when an IPA is on the table. Use your rival's speed: inflate the oak barrel with +3 raises that look like beer enthusiasm, then pull out cold. The draft pint and the honey toast are safe mid-price values that almost no one contests. And if the dented can or the flat one comes up, don't touch them even to inflate: some rivals will drink them out of pride and leave you holding the punishment.
Tacos al pastor, birria con consomé, coc: Tacos al pastor, birria with consommé, cochinita pibil, carnitas and homemade guacamole against the broken tortilla, the jarred sauce, the wilted lettuce and the cold taco. The Mexican theme of the catalogue: here cheese and tomato do not rule, the corn tortilla rules, and the broken tortilla is the definitive punishment. In between, fish taco, shrimp taco, chicharrón, chopped onion, fresh cilantro and brava red sauce complete a taqueria where the spicy food is paid separately and you suffer for free. With horchata to put out the fire, it is the tastiest theme to play with a craving.
¿La tortilla y el pastor salen siempre?: Do the tortilla and al pastor always come out?
El pastor manda, con la birria con conso: Al pastor rules, with birria consommé and cochinita pibil completing the podium.
En la subasta pica en monedas: es un íte: At the auction it stings in coins: it's a mid-tier item that usually goes for more than it's worth out of pure pride.
Los tacos se juegan con hambre y con cab: Tacos are played with hunger and a cool head at the same time: al pastor tempts from the first round, but birria and cochinita decide more games for fewer coins. Since the corn tortilla always comes out, don't overpay for it: it's a base, not a jewel. Jarred sauce and the broken tortilla are your inflation weapons, because no real Mexican lets them pass without bidding out of pride. And watch out for the cold greasy taco: it seems harmless and it's the item that has ruined the most games with one extra +1.
Bohemian Rhapsody, Despacito, YMCA, My W: Bohemian Rhapsody, Despacito, YMCA, My Way, Bailando, Total Eclipse of the Heart, Sweet Caroline, Macarena, Wannabe and Superstition are the items that everyone wants to have to sing at the end. In front, La Mayonesa, El Baile del Gorila, Chihuahua, Holiday Rap and Happy Birthday as historical punishment, with Barbie Girl, La Bamba, Aserejé and Sopa de Cacol as a total party zone. Playing this theme while someone sings each item that comes out is a different experience: the auction becomes a concert and whoever goes out of tune pays the price twice. The favorite for group nights.
El Baile del Gorila y La Mayonesa se dis: El Baile del Gorila and La Mayonesa compete for the title, with Chihuahua completing the horror podium.
El karaoke se canta y se puja con el cor: Karaoke is sung and bid from the heart: let your rival ruin themselves with Bohemian Rhapsody while you close with My Way, Sweet Caroline and Wannabe, anthems that come out at half the price. El Baile del Gorila and La Mayonesa are perfect inflators because no one wants them but everyone sings the chorus. And go after Superstition and Total Eclipse: great songs that reggaeton-only players ignore and leave cheap.
Los libros premian al farsante culto: de: Books reward the cultured faker: let your rival pay for Don Quixote at manuscript price while you close with 1984, Frankenstein and Dracula, which perform equally well for less. Twilight and After are luxury inflators: no one defends them in public, but almost everyone bids "to spite" and keeps them. And go after La Celestina and The Metamorphosis, classics that best-seller-only readers ignore and leave cheap.
Los podcasts se juegan por hábitos: cada: Podcasts are played on habit: each player overvalues what they listen to every day, so let the rival pay a premium for their favorite show while you close with Criminopatía, La Escóbula and Tengo un Plan. The eternal talk show and the 40-minute ad are universal inflators: every listener hates them and almost everyone bites. And go after ROCA Project and Loop Infinito, shows that comedy-only listeners don't know and leave cheap.
El pop es demografía: si tu rival es may: Pop is demographics: if your rival is older, let them pay Michael Jackson and Madonna while you close with Bad Bunny, Rosalía and Billie Eilish. If your rival is young, reverse the move with Freddie and Beyoncé, who are left cheap by young people. Rebecca Black and Nickelback are universal inflators: no one defends them. And go after Bruno Mars and Ed Sheeran, safe values that almost no one fights seriously.
Hogwarts se juega por casas: identifica: Hogwarts is played by houses: identify if your rival is from heroes or from Slytherin and exploit it with their side. Let them pay Harry or Dumbledore while you close with Hermione, McGonagall and Dobby, who perform equally well for less. Filch and Dudley are perfect inflators because no one defends them. And go after Luna and Neville: beloved secondary players who come out cheap and decide games in silence.
La Velada es espectáculo: el rival paga: La Velada is a spectacle: the rival pays more for their favorite streamer, so let them get excited about the main event and close with Viruzz, Momo and Jagger, real fighters who come out cheap. The KO in the first round is your inflator: nobody wants it but everyone talks about it. And go after Coscu, Luzu and Perxitaa: veterans of the event that the new ones do not value and who deliver in silence.
One Piece premia la tripulación completa: One Piece rewards the entire crew: let the rival pay Luffy at the price of a pirate king and set up your gang with Zoro, Sanji, Robin and Brook for fewer coins. Spandam and Wapol are ideal inflators because even non-fans hate them by hearsay. And go after Usopp, Chopper and Franky: the low band that anime-only players undervalue and that closes out championship teams.
El freestyle es réplica: deja que el riv: Freestyle is about the reply: let the rival pay for their battler (almost always Chuty or Gazir) and build your team with Skone, Blon, Mecha and Larrix, who improvise just as well for less. Tirpa, Force and Bnet are golden inflators: other people's wit bids on its own. And go after Marithea, Sara Socas and Teorema: battlers that Spain-only fans don't know and who come out at a first-round price.
El rap de estudio se juega por discograf: Studio rap is played by discographies: let the rival pay Canserbero at a legendary price while you close with Nach, Residente and Mala Rodríguez, who perform the same for less. Foyone and ToteKing are perfect inflators: no one wants them but everyone has an opinion. And go after Ana Tijoux, Orishas and Control Machete: many don't know Latin rap and it comes at a bargain price in Spanish games.
La NBA es gestión salarial: deja que el: The NBA is salary management: let the rival pay the GOAT tax for Jordan or LeBron and build your quintet with Curry, Duncan, Giannis and Jokic, who decide the same for less. The busts (Bennett, Kwame, Darko) are perfect inflators: draft failures bid themselves. And go after Scalabrine and Iverson: cult items that come cheap and close teams with character.
El anime moderno es velocidad: las serie: Modern anime is speed: the series are broadcast and the values are set by the weekly hype, so the rival overpays for what they saw yesterday. Let Gojo pay at cover price while you close with Frieren, Stark and Fern, who perform equally well for less. Kazuya and the vending girl are textbook inflators: no one defends them. And go after Igris and Rimuru, items that shonen-only fans are unaware of and leave at a bargain price.
Los legendarios son generaciones: deja q: The legendaries are generations: let the rival pay for their childhood (Mewtwo for those from Kanto, Rayquaza for those from Hoenn) and close with Lugia, Ho-Oh, Dialga and Giratina. Keldeo and Phione are luxury inflators: the debate over their status bids itself. And go after Celebi, Jirachi and Victini: small mythicals that almost no one fights and that decide games in silence.
Los Simpson igualan a todos: como nadie: The Simpsons make everyone equal: since no one has a knowledge advantage, pure bankroll management wins. Don't pay the protagonist's price for Homer in round 1: Bart, Lisa and Marge perform almost the same and come out cheaper when the rival has already spent. Gil is your inflator: everyone has been Gil at some point and almost everyone bites. And go after the beloved supporting characters (Ralph, Duffman, Dr. Nick): collective affection makes them perform above their price.
Los superhéroes son egos con capa: deja: Superheroes are egos with capes: let your rival pay the fan tax for Batman or Spider-Man while you close with Thor, Hulk and the Joker, who perform the same for less. The ridiculous ones (Polka-Dot Man, Condiment King, Arm-Fall-Off-Boy) are gold pumpers: no one wants them but everyone laughs while bidding. And go after Black Widow and Doctor Strange: secondary characters that movie-only fans undervalue and sell at a bargain price.
Dragon Ball es nostalgia con cola de mon: Dragon Ball is nostalgia with a monkey's tail: the rival pays more for their favorite saga, so let it be ruined with Goku or Vegeta and close with Piccolo, Trunks and Android 18. Chiaotzu and Bacterian are perfect inflators because no one defends them even out of affection. And go after Bulma and Mr. Satan: non-fighters that purists despise and who win games for a laugh.
El K-pop es fandom puro: detecta el bias: K-pop is pure fandom: detect your opponent's bias in the first round and exploit it mercilessly. Let them pay BTS while you close with Stray Kids, SEVENTEEN and aespa, who perform the same for less. Fake entry and playback are perfect inflators: every fan fears them. And go after IU, TXT and ITZY: items that BTS-only fans are unaware of and leave at merchandising prices.
Del Don Quijote a 1984, pasando por Cien: From Don Quixote to 1984, passing through One Hundred Years of Solitude, The Lord of the Rings, Crime and Punishment, Pride and Prejudice, Frankenstein, Dracula, The Hobbit and Moby Dick: it is the most "respectable" theme in the catalogue... until Twilight, Fifty Shades, After, Boulevard and a Wattpad novel appear. The auction ends up being a public confession of embarrassing readings, with The Da Vinci Code and World War Z as a gray area where no one can agree. Between La Celestina, The Metamorphosis and The Shadow of the Wind, each round is a tricky general knowledge exam.
Coello, Tapia, Triay, Brea y Galán con S: Coello, Tapia, Triay, Brea and Galán with Salazar, Josemaría and the lethal viper, against the ball off the glass and the broken racket. The theme of the sport played in every neighborhood: here you bid for the number ones and the fence makes you suffer.
¿Quiénes son los números uno del pádel?: Who are the number ones in padel?
Coello y Tapia en chicos, Triay y Brea e: Coello and Tapia in men's, Triay and Brea in women's: they dominate the Premier Padel circuit and the auction.
Nadie Sabe Nada, La Ruina, ROCA Project,: Nadie Sabe Nada, La Ruina, ROCA Project, The Wild Project, Criminopatía, El Partidazo, El Larguero, La Fórmula del Éxito, Tengo un Plan, Loop Infinito, La Escóbula and Dossier Negro against the eternal talk show, the 40-minute ad, the guest who never shows, the lost episode and the mid-show ad. It is the most "on the go" theme in the catalog: each item is a different companion for the commute, and arguing about which one deserves your ears is half the game.
¿Cuál es el podcast más pujado?: What is the most bid-on podcast?
Nadie Sabe Nada suele encabezar, con La: Nadie Sabe Nada usually leads, with La Ruina very close in the decisions.
Sí: El Partidazo y El Larguero represent: Yes: El Partidazo and El Larguero represent classic sports radio reinvented.
La tertulia eterna y la cuña de 40 minut: The eternal talk show and the 40-minute ad: punishments every listener painfully recognizes.
Criminopatía y Dossier Negro son valores: Criminopatía and Dossier Negro are medium-high values that almost no one fights hard enough for.
Canserbero, Kase.O, Nach y Residente con: Canserbero, Kase.O, Nach and Residente against Foyone and ToteKing, with Mala Rodríguez, SFDK, Natos and Waor, Violadores del Verso, Orishas, Vico C, Tego Calderón, Ana Tijoux, Control Machete, Akapellah, Lil Supa, Alcolirykoz, La Etnnia and El Chojin in the middle. The theme of studio MCs: lyrics rule here, not improvisation, and every bid sparks a debate about who has the best album. The favorite theme to play with someone while rap plays in the background.
¿Salen gallos como Aczino o Trueno?: Do battle rappers like Aczino or Trueno appear?
No: los batalleros tienen su propia temá: No: battle rappers have their own theme in Freestylers; only studio rappers are included here.
Foyone y ToteKing: castigos que ni los m: Foyone and ToteKing: punishments that not even the most hardcore rappers defend in public.
Chuty, Gazir, Aczino, Wos, Skone, Blon,: Chuty, Gazir, Aczino, Wos, Skone, Blon, Walls, Mecha, Larrix, El Menor, Nitro, Letra, Teorema, Marithea and Sara Socas with Arkano as master of ceremonies, against Tirpa, Force, Sweet Pain and Bnet. With Red Bull and the FMS in the background, it is the loudest theme in the catalog.
Aquí solo batalleros de improvisación; l: Here only improvisation battlers compete; studio MCs have their own theme in Rappers.
En la subasta sí: es el castigo con más: In the auction, yes: it is the best-known punishment in the theme, perfect for inflating the price.
Nokia 3310, iPhone 4, Motorola RAZR y Bl: Nokia 3310, iPhone 4, Motorola RAZR and BlackBerry versus Amazon Fire Phone and YotaPhone. It is the most nostalgic theme for those who lived through the shift from brick phones to smartphones, and a history lesson for younger players.
Por su fama de indestructible y por ser: Because of its reputation for being indestructible and for being the first phone of an entire generation; it is the most bid-on item in the theme.
León salvaje, águila real y delfín compi: Wild lion, golden eagle and dolphin compete with the Labrador puppy, the orange kitten and even an axolotl, while the pet cockroach and the buzzing mosquito wait their turn. It is the most tender theme in the catalog, and also the funniest when the bad items show up.
Wyatt Earp, Billy el Niño, Doc Holliday: Wyatt Earp, Billy the Kid, Doc Holliday and Jesse James at an Old West auction, with broken boots and a broken lasso as punishment. The theme of duels at sundown, perfect for those who grew up on westerns.
El dentista y pistolero que acompañó a W: The dentist and gunslinger who accompanied Wyatt Earp in the O.K. Corral duel; it is one of the most bid-on items.
Sí, es uno de los ítems más pujados, jun: Yes, it is one of the most bid-on items, along with MrBeast and El Rubius.

Temáticas que van del bar de siempre a l: Themes range from the usual bar to pizza, including tacos, the air fryer, Sunday BBQ, Viral Desserts or craft beer. Great for playing before dinner or discussing what goes into a perfect burger.
El asado de domingo convertido en subast: The Sunday BBQ turned into an auction: ribeye aged 45 days, brisket smoked twelve hours, oak embers, homemade chimichurri, BBQ ribs and a cast iron grill in front of a moist charcoal, some pre-cooked sausages or a charred meat. It is the most "after-dinner" theme of all, perfect to play while making real food, with cold beer as a wild card item that always encourages bidding. In between, Moorish skewers, Creole chorizo and roasted corn complete a grill where almost everything is desired and almost everything can be paid dearly on impulse.

Puedes jugarla en la temática Repostería: You can play it in the Viral Desserts theme (linked below). If the group is large, the most practical thing is to have two play per game and have the rest act as a jury, or rotate the winner.
Si la mesa es más mayor, Series o Música: If the table skews older, TV Series or Music unlock memories and conversation. And for sibling rivalry, Soccer or Pizza don't fail.

Para el plan de chiringuito, nada como T: For the beach bar plan, nothing like Tapas and Bar with a cold Craft Beer: Iberian ham, tortilla and Galician-style octopus against the last olive on the plate. And if there are embers involved, the Sunday BBQ extends the meal with steak against wet charcoal.
Tapas, Craft Beer y Asado de Domingo sue: Tapas, Craft Beer and Sunday BBQ are usually the favorites, especially if the group is from the beach, beach bar or barbecue.
La temática oficial de la noche es Repos: The official theme of the night is Viral Desserts: tiramisu, coulant, Basque cheesecake and churros with punishments as fun as the instant flan. Whoever builds the best dessert table wins, and the competition for who gets the coulant is guaranteed.
La primera es la clásica: una partida a: The first is the classic: a game of Viral Desserts and a rematch with the same theme to break the tie. The second is blind: choose "All (random)" and play without knowing which list is playing until the first item appears. And the third is a best-of-three league: each person chooses a theme and the third is random, so no one has an advantage.
